keyEvents.text: Goal! Marseille 1, Toulouse 0. Amine Harit (Marseille) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Amine Gouiri.
Delay in match because of an injury Emerson (Marseille).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Marseille. Ulisses Garcia replaces Emerson because of an injury.
Goal! Marseille 2, Toulouse 0. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Igor Paixão with a headed pass.
Pierre-Emile Højbjerg (Marseille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Toulouse. Sion Oppong replaces Aron Dønnum.
